words.enDefinition: covered by a warranty that is still in force

examples.en: The headphones were still under warranty when the left side stopped playing sound.
examples.zh: 左边不出声时，这副耳机仍「在保修期内」。

examples.en: I checked whether the charger was under warranty before contacting the shop about it.
examples.zh: 联系商店咨询前，我确认了充电器是不是「在保修期内」。

words.enDefinition: no longer covered because the warranty period has ended

examples.en: My laptop was out of warranty when the screen stopped turning on that week.
examples.zh: 那周屏幕无法点亮时，我的笔记本电脑「已超出保修期」。

examples.en: The shop said the original speaker was out of warranty by a few months.
examples.zh: 店家说原来的音箱已经「过了保修期」几个月。

words.enDefinition: a written or stated promise from the maker about covering specified product problems

examples.en: The manufacturer's warranty came in the box alongside a small instruction booklet.
examples.zh: 「厂商保修」说明和一本小指南一起装在盒子里。

examples.en: I asked whether the manufacturer's warranty applied to the battery as well as the screen.
examples.zh: 我问「厂商保修」是否同时涵盖电池和屏幕。

words.enDefinition: a promise from the seller to handle specified faults with purchased goods

examples.en: The shop offered a retailer warranty on the refurbished monitor I needed for class.
examples.zh: 店里为我上课需要的翻新显示器提供「零售商保修」。

examples.en: I checked which address to use for repairs covered by the retailer warranty.
examples.zh: 我确认了「零售商保修」范围内的维修要寄到哪个地址。

words.enDefinition: a warranty that restricts its coverage or remedies in specified ways

examples.en: The limited warranty covered the main unit but listed separate conditions for the cable.
examples.zh: 「有限保修」涵盖主机，不过线缆另有条款。

examples.en: I read the limited warranty to see how long the replacement keyboard was covered.
examples.zh: 我看了「有限保修」，想知道替换键盘能保修多久。

words.enDefinition: in US consumer warranty law, a written warranty meeting specified federal requirements for coverage

examples.en: The US brochure placed full warranty and limited warranty under two separate headings.
examples.zh: 美国的宣传册把「美国完全保修」和有限保修放在两个不同的标题下。

examples.en: I asked the clerk which parts of the equipment the full warranty described.
examples.zh: 我问店员，「美国完全保修」说明中提到了设备的哪些部件。

collocations: product sold with a full warranty

words.enDefinition: an agreement that adds protection beyond the original product warranty

examples.en: I compared the extended warranty with the coverage already included with the laptop.
examples.zh: 我把「延长保修」与笔记本电脑原本自带的保修范围做了比较。

examples.en: The total for the monitor did not include the optional extended warranty at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时，显示器的总价没有包含可选的「延长保修」。

words.enDefinition: a warranty described as lasting for a lifetime defined by its terms

examples.en: I checked what lifetime warranty meant in the booklet for my new backpack.
examples.zh: 我查看了新背包手册，想知道里面的「终身保修」是什么意思。

examples.en: The brand's lifetime warranty page explained whether lifetime referred to the product or its owner.
examples.zh: 品牌的「终身保修」页面说明了这里是指产品的使用寿命还是所有者的寿命。

words.enDefinition: a warranty that can pass from the original buyer to a later owner

examples.en: The seller included a transferable warranty with the used laptop I bought for class.
examples.zh: 卖家给我上课用的二手笔记本电脑附了一份「可转让的保修」。

examples.en: I asked whether a transferable warranty went with the camera after it was sold.
examples.zh: 我问相机卖掉后，有没有「可转让的保修」随相机一起转给买家。

words.enDefinition: a promise about product coverage recorded in a document

examples.en: I saved a copy of the written warranty with the receipt from the shop.
examples.zh: 我把「书面保修承诺」副本与商店收据一起保存。

examples.en: The assistant showed me where the written warranty listed the excluded parts for the device.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了「书面保修承诺」上哪里列着设备不在保修范围内的部件。

words.enDefinition: a warranty that can arise by law without an express promise from the seller

examples.en: The US consumer guide explained implied warranty in its section on everyday purchases.
examples.zh: 美国消费者指南在日常购买一节中解释了「默示担保」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a broken toaster to illustrate an implied warranty in the reading.
examples.zh: 导师借坏掉的烤面包机说明阅读材料中的「默示担保」。

words.enDefinition: a warranty created by a stated promise about a product or its performance

examples.en: The brochure included an express warranty about the battery rather than a general slogan.
examples.zh: 宣传册中对电池作出了「明示担保」，写得比宣传口号具体。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which statements in the advertisement might count as an express warranty.
examples.zh: 导师问广告里的哪些表述可能算「明示担保」。

words.enDefinition: an Australian term for a promise to provide a specified remedy if a product has a defect

examples.en: The Australian consumer guide discusses a warranty against defects under its own heading.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚消费者指南有单独一节介绍「缺陷保修承诺」。

examples.en: I checked who issued the warranty against defects for the small kitchen appliance.
examples.zh: 我核对了这件小厨电的「缺陷保修承诺」由谁提供。

collocations: make a claim under a warranty against defects

words.enDefinition: an implied promise under US law that goods are suitable for their ordinary use

examples.en: The US reading used a kettle to illustrate the warranty of merchantability in class.
examples.zh: 美国的阅读材料用水壶说明课堂上的「适销性默示担保」。

examples.en: I looked up warranty of merchantability after seeing the phrase in a consumer guide.
examples.zh: 我在消费者指南上看到这个短语后，查了「适销性默示担保」。

collocations: breach of the warranty of merchantability

words.expression: warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
words.lemma: warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
words.zhGloss: 特定用途适用性默示担保
words.enDefinition: a US implied warranty when the seller knows the buyer's specific purpose and the buyer relies on the seller's judgement
acceptedZhAnswers: 特定用途适用性默示担保
acceptedEnVariants: warranty of fitness for a particular purpose

examples.en: Our US course guide listed warranty of fitness for a particular purpose under implied warranties.
examples.zh: 我们的美国课程指南把「特定用途适用性默示担保」列在默示担保下。

examples.en: The lecturer discussed the warranty of fitness for a particular purpose in a camping example.
examples.zh: 讲师用一个露营例子讲解了「特定用途适用性默示担保」。

collocations: implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
claim involving a warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
breach of a warranty of fitness for a particular purpose

words.enDefinition: a protection given to consumers by law for qualifying goods or services

examples.en: The Australian handout used a faulty desk lamp to explain a consumer guarantee.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的讲义用一盏有故障的台灯说明「消费者法定保障」。

examples.en: I saw consumer guarantee in the official guide next to examples about repairs.
examples.zh: 我在官方指南的维修示例旁看到了「消费者法定保障」。

words.enDefinition: suitable for the job or use expected of the product

examples.en: I asked whether the bag was fit for purpose as a laptop carrier on rainy days.
examples.zh: 我问这个包在雨天装笔记本电脑，是否「适合预定用途」。

examples.en: The reviewer said the inexpensive stand was fit for purpose in a small study room.
examples.zh: 评论者说，这个便宜的支架用在小自习室里「适合预定用途」。

collocations: goods that are fit for purpose
make sure something is fit for purpose

words.zhGloss: 商品应达到的合理质量
words.enDefinition: in Australian consumer usage, the standard of quality people can reasonably expect for particular goods
acceptedZhAnswers: 商品应达到的合理质量

examples.en: The Australian guide discussed acceptable quality using examples of new and secondhand products.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南用新品和二手商品的实例介绍「商品应达到的合理质量」。

examples.en: I read the part about acceptable quality before speaking to the store about my order.
examples.zh: 去找店家问订单之前，我读了关于「商品应达到的合理质量」的那一部分。

words.enDefinition: a way of addressing a consumer problem, such as repairing or replacing goods

examples.en: The guide gave an example of a consumer remedy for a faulty kitchen appliance.
examples.zh: 指南举了一个厨电故障后的「消费者补救方式」示例。

examples.en: Our class compared which consumer remedy each scenario in the worksheet described that week.
examples.zh: 那周我们在课堂上比较了练习单每种情况描述的「消费者补救方式」。

words.enDefinition: the length of time during which a product's warranty applies

examples.en: I checked the warranty period because the screen started flickering almost a year later.
examples.zh: 屏幕差不多隔了一年才开始闪烁，我就查了「保修期」。

examples.en: The information sheet gave a shorter warranty period for the included battery pack.
examples.zh: 说明单上写着，随附电池的「保修期」更短。

words.enDefinition: the date when a product's warranty is due to end

examples.en: I wrote the warranty expiry date next to the purchase date in my notebook.
examples.zh: 我把「保修截止日期」记在笔记本的购买日期旁边。

examples.en: The service page showed my warranty expiry date after I entered the serial number.
examples.zh: 输入序列号后，服务页面显示了我的「保修截止日期」。

words.enDefinition: the date from which a warranty begins to apply

examples.en: The help centre asked for the warranty start date printed on the product record.
examples.zh: 服务中心要求提供产品记录上印的「保修起始日期」。

examples.en: I compared the warranty start date with the day the retailer dispatched my order.
examples.zh: 我把「保修起始日期」与零售商发出订单的日期做了对照。

words.enDefinition: a document identifying a product and recording the attached warranty

examples.en: The shop stamped the warranty certificate before putting it back inside the box.
examples.zh: 商店为「保修凭证」盖了章，再将它放回盒内。

examples.en: I found the warranty certificate underneath the cable and the printed user guide.
examples.zh: 我在数据线和纸质用户指南下面找到了「保修凭证」。

words.enDefinition: a small booklet containing a product's warranty information

examples.en: I read the warranty booklet to see who handled repair requests outside my city.
examples.zh: 我读了「保修手册」，想知道本市之外由谁受理维修申请。

examples.en: The warranty booklet had a table showing which accessories were covered by the promise.
examples.zh: 「保修手册」有张表，写着哪些配件在承诺范围内。

words.enDefinition: the conditions describing what a warranty provides and how it applies

examples.en: I checked the warranty terms before taking the speakers to a local repair shop.
examples.zh: 把音箱拿去本地维修店前，我先查了「保修条款」。

examples.en: The warranty terms listed a separate contact address for items bought outside the country.
examples.zh: 「保修条款」为境外购买的商品另列了一个联系地址。

words.enDefinition: faults or situations explicitly left outside the scope of a warranty

examples.en: The warranty exclusions explained which kinds of damage the manufacturer would assess separately.
examples.zh: 「保修除外事项」说明了哪些损坏情形需要由生产商另行评估。

examples.en: I noticed the warranty exclusions after reading the cover promised for electrical faults.
examples.zh: 看完针对电气故障的保障后，我注意到了「保修除外事项」。

words.enDefinition: the faults, parts, services, or costs included in a warranty

examples.en: The website showed different warranty coverage for the main unit and the battery.
examples.zh: 网站显示，主机和电池的「保修范围」不同。

examples.en: I contacted support to confirm the warranty coverage before dropping off my laptop.
examples.zh: 我先联系了客服确认「保修范围」，才把笔记本电脑送去。

words.enDefinition: the part of an original warranty period that has not yet elapsed

examples.en: I asked about the remaining warranty before paying for the used coffee machine.
examples.zh: 为二手咖啡机付款之前，我问了「剩余保修期限」。

examples.en: The receipt listed the remaining warranty for the replacement item separately from its price.
examples.zh: 收据把替换品的「剩余保修期限」与价格分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the process of recording the buyer and a specific product with its maker or seller

examples.en: I completed product registration after finding the serial number on the bottom of the device.
examples.zh: 我在设备底部找到序列号后，完成了「产品登记」。

examples.en: The confirmation email arrived shortly after I submitted the product registration for my headphones.
examples.zh: 我提交耳机的「产品登记」后不久，就收到了确认邮件。

words.enDefinition: Dell's identifier for finding a specific device in its support system

examples.en: I found the Service Tag beside the barcode on the underside of my Dell laptop.
examples.zh: 我在戴尔笔记本电脑底面的条形码旁找到了「设备服务编号」。

examples.en: The agent used the Service Tag to find my Dell monitor in her system.
examples.zh: 客服用「设备服务编号」在系统里找到了我的戴尔显示器。

words.enDefinition: a separately purchased agreement to provide specified maintenance or repair services

examples.en: The shop offered a service contract for the printer while I was at the checkout.
examples.zh: 我在结账时，商店为这台打印机提供了「付费维修服务合约」选项。

examples.en: I asked what the service contract would cover after the original warranty ended.
examples.zh: 我问原保修期结束后，「付费维修服务合约」会涵盖什么。

words.enDefinition: a separately offered plan covering specified breakdowns, damage, or service costs

examples.en: I compared the protection plan with the cover included in the original warranty.
examples.zh: 我把「产品保障方案」与原保修承诺中的保障做了比较。

examples.en: The shop printed the protection plan terms on a sheet apart from the receipt.
examples.zh: 店家把「产品保障方案」的条款单独打印，没有和收据印在一起。

words.enDefinition: coverage for specified damage resulting from an unexpected accident

examples.en: I read about accidental damage protection before deciding whether to buy the plan.
examples.zh: 我先看了有关「意外损坏保障」的说明，才决定是否买这个方案。

examples.en: The adviser said the screen replacement fell under accidental damage protection in my plan.
examples.zh: 客服说，按我的方案，更换屏幕属于「意外损坏保障」。

words.enDefinition: replacement materials and the work involved in making a repair

examples.en: The shop's estimate included parts and labour for the repair of my desk lamp.
examples.zh: 店家的报价包括维修台灯的「零件及人工」。

examples.en: I asked whether parts and labour were both covered for the speaker replacement.
examples.zh: 我问更换音箱时，「零件及人工」是否都在保障范围内。

words.enDefinition: a warranty covering specified replacement parts without paying for the installation work

examples.en: The invoice mentioned a parts-only warranty below the cost of replacing the battery.
examples.zh: 发票在换电池的费用下标明了「仅保零件的保修」。

examples.en: I checked whether the parts-only warranty applied to the new power supply as well.
examples.zh: 我确认了「仅保零件的保修」是否也适用于新的电源。

words.enDefinition: a fault that comes within the scope of a warranty or plan

examples.en: The technician confirmed the loose socket was a covered defect after inspecting the monitor.
examples.zh: 维修人员检查显示器后，确认松动的插口是「在保修范围内的缺陷」。

examples.en: The booklet listed an example of a covered defect near the warranty contact details.
examples.zh: 手册在保修联系方式旁举了一个「在保修范围内的缺陷」的例子。

words.enDefinition: a fault introduced during the manufacture or assembly of an item

examples.en: The customer service team suspected a manufacturing defect in the loose hinge on my laptop.
examples.zh: 客服团队怀疑，我笔记本电脑的铰链松动属于「制造缺陷」。

examples.en: The report separated a manufacturing defect from damage to the box during shipping.
examples.zh: 报告把「制造缺陷」和运输途中外箱损坏分开记录。

words.enDefinition: a fault in the material used to make a product or component

examples.en: The repair shop traced the cracking handle to a material defect in the plastic.
examples.zh: 维修店查明，把手开裂是塑料的「材料缺陷」造成的。

examples.en: The manufacturer sent a report describing the material defect found under the outer layer.
examples.zh: 厂商发来报告，说明了外层下面发现的「材料缺陷」。

words.enDefinition: a fault caused by how an item was manufactured, assembled, or repaired

examples.en: The loose stitching was described as a defect in workmanship on the inspection form.
examples.zh: 检验表把缝线松脱描述为「加工装配缺陷」。

examples.en: Our design class discussed whether the misaligned hinge showed a defect in workmanship after assembly.
examples.zh: 设计课上，我们讨论了铰链装好后没有对齐是否属于「加工装配缺陷」。

collocations: check for a defect in workmanship

words.enDefinition: damage due to contact with water or another liquid

examples.en: The report recorded liquid damage after the technician inspected the keyboard and its connectors.
examples.zh: 维修人员检查键盘和接口后，报告记录了「液体造成的损坏」。

examples.en: I asked whether the estimate for liquid damage included the cost of a new keyboard.
examples.zh: 我问处理「液体造成的损坏」的报价里包不包含新键盘的费用。

words.enDefinition: damage caused by a product striking something or being hit

examples.en: The technician photographed the impact damage along the lower edge of the screen.
examples.zh: 维修人员拍下了屏幕下边缘的「撞击损坏」。

examples.en: The inspection note said no impact damage was visible around the cracked hinge.
examples.zh: 检验记录写着，开裂的铰链周围没有可见的「撞击损坏」。

words.enDefinition: use of a product in a way it was not designed or intended for

examples.en: The warranty booklet gave examples of misuse under the heading about excluded damage.
examples.zh: 保修手册在除外损坏一节中列举了「不当使用」的例子。

examples.en: The technician asked how the appliance had been used before deciding whether there was misuse.
examples.zh: 维修人员询问了电器的使用情况，再判断是否有「不当使用」。

words.enDefinition: work carried out by someone without approval from the relevant service provider

examples.en: The report described the earlier work as an unauthorized repair by an unknown shop.
examples.zh: 报告把之前的工作记为一家不知名店铺所做的「未经授权的维修」。

examples.en: I asked what the warranty wording meant by unauthorized repair on the last page.
examples.zh: 我问保修条款最后一页的「未经授权的维修」指什么。

words.enDefinition: a part not made or supplied as an original component by the product manufacturer

examples.en: The independent shop explained why it had fitted a non-genuine part in the printer.
examples.zh: 独立维修店解释了为什么在打印机里装了「非原厂部件」。

examples.en: I asked whether the estimate named the maker of the non-genuine part being offered.
examples.zh: 我问报价里有没有写所提供的「非原厂部件」由谁制造。

words.enDefinition: a part the product maker has accepted as suitable for use in a repair

examples.en: The service center ordered a manufacturer-approved part after checking the laptop's model number.
examples.zh: 维修中心核对笔记本电脑的型号后，订购了「厂商认可部件」。

examples.en: The estimate said a manufacturer-approved part would be used for the damaged connector.
examples.zh: 报价注明，损坏的接口会使用「厂商认可部件」来更换。

words.enDefinition: a component kept or sold to replace a damaged or worn part

examples.en: Our lab technician kept a spare part for the mixer in the cupboard beside the sink.
examples.zh: 实验室技术人员在水槽旁的橱柜里为搅拌机留了一个「备用零件」。

examples.en: The technician found the correct spare part after checking the model in her catalogue.
examples.zh: 维修人员在目录里核对型号后，找到了合适的「备用零件」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the manufacturer no longer produces a component

examples.en: The service page showed part discontinued when I entered the old camera's model number.
examples.zh: 我输入旧相机的型号时，服务页面显示「零件已停产」。

examples.en: The technician wrote part discontinued beside the replacement socket in her estimate that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，维修人员在报价单上的替换插口旁写了「零件已停产」。

words.enDefinition: a status meaning that a particular warranty no longer applies

examples.en: The service team wrote warranty void on its decision about the damaged headphones.
examples.zh: 服务团队在有关损坏耳机的决定上写了「保修失效」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the system showed warranty void for that serial number.
examples.zh: 客服解释了为什么系统对那个序列号显示「保修失效」。

words.enDefinition: wording on a label stating a warranty condition about removing the label or component

examples.en: The repair form asked whether the seal marked “Warranty void if removed” was intact.
examples.zh: 维修表问，写着「标签拆除则保修失效」的封签是否完好。

examples.en: I photographed the sticker saying “Warranty void if removed” for the support representative.
examples.zh: 我把写着「标签拆除则保修失效」的标签拍给了客服。

words.enDefinition: a request for a repair, replacement, or other remedy under a warranty

examples.en: I submitted a warranty claim after the shop checked the purchase date on my receipt.
examples.zh: 商店核对了收据上的购买日期后，我提交了「保修申请」。

examples.en: The service team asked for a brief description of the fault in my warranty claim.
examples.zh: 服务团队请我在「保修申请」中简要说明故障。

words.enDefinition: a form used to give details needed to assess a warranty claim

examples.en: The warranty claim form had a separate box for the product's full model number.
examples.zh: 「保修申请表」上有一栏专门填写产品的完整型号。

examples.en: I attached a picture of the loose hinge to my warranty claim form that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我把松动铰链的照片附在了「保修申请表」上。

collocations: fill in a warranty claim form

words.enDefinition: a unique number used to identify a request made under a warranty

examples.en: I read out the warranty claim number when the clerk answered the service line.
examples.zh: 客服接通服务热线时，我报出了「保修申请编号」。

examples.en: The email put my warranty claim number beside the date it received the product.
examples.zh: 邮件把「保修申请编号」放在收到产品的日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: the current stage or outcome of a request under a warranty

examples.en: The account showed my warranty claim status after I verified the serial number online.
examples.zh: 我在网上验证序列号后，账户显示了「保修申请进度」。

examples.en: I checked the warranty claim status before deciding whether to borrow another computer for class.
examples.zh: 我先查了「保修申请进度」，再决定要不要借另一台电脑上课。

words.enDefinition: repair or other assistance provided within the terms of a warranty

examples.en: The local shop handled warranty service for the monitor I bought at another branch.
examples.zh: 本地门店受理了我在另一家分店买的显示器的「保修服务」。

examples.en: I asked where warranty service was available after moving to a new city for school.
examples.zh: 我搬到一座新城市读书后，询问哪里可以获得「保修服务」。

words.enDefinition: a substitute item provided to resolve a fault covered by a warranty

examples.en: The warranty replacement arrived before the start of classes in the autumn term.
examples.zh: 「保修替换品」在秋季学期开课前到了。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the warranty replacement had the same port as my old monitor.
examples.zh: 店员确认了「保修替换品」是否与我旧显示器的接口相同。

words.enDefinition: excluded from the protection provided by the warranty

examples.en: The message said the damaged cable was not covered under warranty for this product.
examples.zh: 消息说，该产品损坏的线缆「不在保修范围内」。

examples.en: The service team listed the repairs not covered under warranty on a separate page.
examples.zh: 服务团队另用一页列出了「不在保修范围内」的维修。

words.enDefinition: a status saying the seller or manufacturer accepted the warranty request

examples.en: The portal read warranty claim approved after the service team inspected the defective screen.
examples.zh: 服务团队检查屏幕故障后，门户网站显示「保修申请已批准」。

examples.en: I got a warranty claim approved notice while waiting for a reply from the shop.
examples.zh: 等店家回复时，我收到了一条「保修申请已批准」的通知。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the warranty provider decided not to accept a request

examples.en: The email said warranty claim denied and included the outcome of the inspection.
examples.zh: 邮件写着「保修申请已被拒」，并附上了检验结果。

examples.en: I checked the part number again after noticing warranty claim denied on the service page.
examples.zh: 我看到服务页面显示「保修申请已被拒」，又查了一遍部件编号。

words.enDefinition: whether the product or request meets the conditions for warranty service

examples.en: The agent checked warranty eligibility using the date on the original sales receipt.
examples.zh: 客服用原始购物小票上的日期核对了「保修适用资格」。

examples.en: I asked what affected warranty eligibility before moving the equipment to my new flat.
examples.zh: 把设备搬到新公寓前，我问了什么会影响「保修适用资格」。

words.enDefinition: a status stating that the service provider sent an item back without repairing it

examples.en: The tracking page showed “Returned without repair” after the manufacturer inspected the monitor.
examples.zh: 生产商检查显示器后，追踪页面显示「未经维修已退回」。

examples.en: A note marked “Returned without repair” explained that the replacement part was no longer available.
examples.zh: 标为「未经维修已退回」的说明写着，替换零件已无法供应。

words.enDefinition: help or advice provided by the maker of a product

examples.en: I contacted manufacturer support when the store could not identify the correct replacement cable.
examples.zh: 商店无法辨认合适的替换线缆时，我联系了「厂商技术支持」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed a separate email address for manufacturer support on its last page.
examples.zh: 宣传单最后一页另列了一个「厂商技术支持」的电子邮件地址。

words.enDefinition: a business approved by a manufacturer to provide specified product services

examples.en: The shop referred me to an authorized service provider closer to the main campus.
examples.zh: 店家让我去离主校区更近的「授权服务机构」。

examples.en: The authorized service provider confirmed which repair jobs it could handle that week.
examples.zh: 「授权服务机构」确认了当周能受理哪些维修。

words.enDefinition: a repair business operating separately from the manufacturer or seller

examples.en: I visited an independent repair shop near campus to ask about the battery replacement.
examples.zh: 我去校园附近一家「独立维修店」咨询更换电池。

examples.en: The independent repair shop gave a separate estimate for the screen and the hinge.
examples.zh: 「独立维修店」分别给屏幕和铰链报了价。

words.enDefinition: the process of receiving and recording an item for repair

examples.en: The technician photographed the laptop during repair intake and asked about the damaged hinge.
examples.zh: 维修人员在「维修收件登记」时给笔记本电脑拍照，并问了铰链损坏的情况。

examples.en: The shop printed a separate receipt at repair intake after checking the serial number.
examples.zh: 店家核对序列号后，在「维修收件登记」时打印了一张单独的收件凭条。

words.enDefinition: a record authorizing or tracking a particular product service or repair

examples.en: The service order listed the device's condition when I brought it to the shop.
examples.zh: 「维修服务单」记录了我把设备送到店里时的状况。

examples.en: The clerk added the missing charger to the notes on my service order.
examples.zh: 店员在我的「维修服务单」备注里补写了未随机器送来的充电器。

words.enDefinition: a reference used to identify a particular repair in a service system

examples.en: I wrote the repair job number on the envelope with my warranty documents.
examples.zh: 我把「维修任务编号」写在放保修文件的信封上。

examples.en: The technician asked for the repair job number before checking the estimated finish date.
examples.zh: 维修人员先问了「维修任务编号」，再查询预计完成日期。

collocations: look up a repair job number

words.enDefinition: a slip listing an item accepted for repair and details of the job

examples.en: The repair docket described the cracked case and gave me a collection reference.
examples.zh: 「维修登记凭单」写明了外壳开裂的情况，还给了一个领取编号。

examples.en: I kept the repair docket in my notebook until the monitor was ready.
examples.zh: 我把「维修登记凭单」夹在笔记本里，直到显示器修好。

words.enDefinition: to take something to a service location and leave it there for repair

examples.en: The librarian showed me which devices I could drop off for repair on campus.
examples.zh: 图书管理员告诉我，哪些设备可以在学校「送去维修」。

examples.en: I called about the printer I planned to drop off for repair that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我打电话咨询那天下午打算「送去维修」的打印机。

collocations: arrange to drop off for repair
devices to drop off for repair
choose where to drop off for repair

words.enDefinition: repair service arranged by sending the item to a service centre by mail

examples.en: The shop offered a mail-in repair because the authorized centre was in another city.
examples.zh: 授权维修中心在另一座城市，所以店里提供「邮寄送修」选项。

examples.en: I checked what to include with a mail-in repair before packing the laptop carefully.
examples.zh: 把笔记本电脑仔细装好前，我查看了「邮寄送修」需要随附哪些东西。

words.enDefinition: service for which the customer takes the product to a repair centre

examples.en: The carry-in service was available at a small shop beside the main bus station.
examples.zh: 总站旁的一家小店提供「自行送修服务」。

examples.en: I chose carry-in service because I could bring the monitor on my way to class.
examples.zh: 我选择了「自行送修服务」，因为去上课时可以顺路把显示器带过去。

words.enDefinition: work carried out by a technician at the customer's location

examples.en: I asked about on-site service because the printer was attached to a large desk.
examples.zh: 打印机固定在大桌子上，所以我咨询了「上门维修服务」。

examples.en: The company arranged on-site service for the shared washing machine in the residence.
examples.zh: 公司为宿舍共用洗衣机安排了「上门维修服务」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary device provided while someone's own equipment is being repaired

examples.en: The repair centre offered a loaner device so I could finish my coursework.
examples.zh: 维修中心提供了「临时借用设备」，这样我还能完成课程作业。

examples.en: I returned the loaner device when my repaired computer was ready on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五自己的电脑修好后，我归还了「临时借用设备」。

words.enDefinition: the time taken from receiving an item for repair until completing the work

examples.en: I asked about the repair turnaround time before leaving the monitor at the shop.
examples.zh: 我先问了「送修到完成所需时间」，才把显示器留在店里。

examples.en: The repair turnaround time increased when the replacement hinge was no longer in stock.
examples.zh: 替换铰链缺货后，「送修到完成所需时间」变长了。

words.enDefinition: a written statement of how much a repair is expected to cost

examples.en: I asked for a written estimate before deciding whether to repair the old laptop.
examples.zh: 决定要不要修旧笔记本电脑之前，我要了一份「书面报价」。

examples.en: The written estimate listed labour separately from the new keyboard and delivery.
examples.zh: 「书面报价」把人工费与新键盘和配送费分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a charge for examining a product to find the cause of a fault

examples.en: The service centre charged a diagnostic fee when I brought the faulty speaker in.
examples.zh: 我把故障音箱送去后，维修中心收了一笔「故障检测费」。

examples.en: I checked whether the diagnostic fee would be applied to the final repair bill.
examples.zh: 我确认了「故障检测费」能否抵扣最终的维修账单。

words.enDefinition: a base charge for taking in and checking equipment at a repair shop's workbench

examples.en: The shop quoted a flat bench fee for checking the record player on its workbench.
examples.zh: 维修店给出了在工作台上检查唱机的固定「工作台检查费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the bench fee was separate from the charge for replacing parts.
examples.zh: 我问「工作台检查费」是不是和更换部件的费用分开算。

words.enDefinition: a fee for sending a technician to the customer's location

examples.en: The repair company listed a call-out charge before the hourly rate for labour.
examples.zh: 维修公司先列出「上门服务费」，再列每小时的人工费。

examples.en: We split the call-out charge because the printer belonged to three flatmates.
examples.zh: 打印机是三个室友共有的，所以我们分摊了「上门服务费」。

words.enDefinition: a repair offered for a set price within specified conditions

examples.en: The shop gave me a flat-rate repair option for the laptop's cracked screen.
examples.zh: 店家为开裂的笔记本电脑屏幕提供了「固定费率维修」选项。

examples.en: I read what the flat-rate repair included before selecting it on the support site.
examples.zh: 在支持网站上选定之前，我看了「固定费率维修」包括哪些项目。

words.enDefinition: a service promise saying that no repair fee is due if the problem is not fixed

examples.en: The shop window advertised no fix no fee for repairs of certain models.
examples.zh: 店面橱窗写着，某些型号的维修「修不好不收费」。

examples.en: I asked what no fix no fee covered before leaving the speaker at the desk.
examples.zh: 把音箱留在柜台前，我问了「修不好不收费」包括哪些费用。

collocations: a no fix no fee policy

words.enDefinition: whether the parts needed for a repair can be obtained in time

examples.en: The technician checked parts availability before giving me a date to collect the equipment.
examples.zh: 维修人员先查了「零件供应情况」，再给我取设备的日期。

examples.en: The shop said its estimate depended on parts availability after the holiday break.
examples.zh: 店家说，报价取决于假期后的「零件供应情况」。

words.enDefinition: to accept the proposed cost so the provider can start the work

examples.en: I waited until I had compared both options before choosing to approve the estimate.
examples.zh: 我比较过两个选项后，才决定「同意按报价维修」。

examples.en: The technician asked whether I could approve the estimate by replying to the email.
examples.zh: 维修人员问我能否回复邮件「同意按报价维修」。

collocations: ask a customer to approve the estimate

words.enDefinition: to tell the provider not to proceed with an offered repair

examples.en: I decided to decline the repair after seeing how much the new display cost.
examples.zh: 看到新屏幕的价格后，我决定「拒绝进行维修」。

examples.en: The form showed which option to select if I wanted to decline the repair.
examples.zh: 表格标明了如果我想「拒绝进行维修」，应该选哪一项。

words.enDefinition: an updated prediction of costs after the quoted work or its requirements change

examples.en: The revised estimate included an additional cable that was missing from the first quote.
examples.zh: 「修订后的报价」增加了第一份报价里没列的一根线。

examples.en: I asked the shop to email the revised estimate before ordering the replacement screen.
examples.zh: 我请店家先通过邮件发来「修订后的报价」，再订购替换屏幕。

words.enDefinition: a status showing an estimate is still being prepared or awaited

examples.en: The service page said estimate pending while the engineer checked the new fault.
examples.zh: 工程师检查新故障期间，服务页面显示「报价待出」。

examples.en: I saw estimate pending beside the repair number when I reopened the email.
examples.zh: 我重新打开邮件，看到维修编号旁写着「报价待出」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing work on the item has started but is unfinished

examples.en: The app displayed repair in progress after the shop received the replacement keyboard.
examples.zh: 维修店收下替换键盘后，应用显示「正在维修」。

examples.en: The repair in progress message gave no date for when the laptop would be ready.
examples.zh: 「正在维修」的消息没有写笔记本电脑哪天能修好。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating the technician finished identifying the problem or checking for faults

examples.en: The service page read diagnosis complete and gave me the technician's contact details.
examples.zh: 服务页面显示「故障检测已完成」，并给了维修人员的联系方式。

examples.en: I found diagnosis complete next to the repair job number on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我在凭条上的维修任务编号旁看到了「故障检测已完成」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a technician verified the reported problem

examples.en: The fault confirmed message explained which connector had caused the monitor to fail.
examples.zh: 「已确认故障」的消息说明了哪个接口导致显示器故障。

examples.en: The report stated fault confirmed after the test reproduced the problem with the power button.
examples.zh: 测试复现了电源键的问题后，报告写着「已确认故障」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a technician could not recreate the reported problem during testing

examples.en: The technician wrote “Fault not reproduced” after testing the phone throughout the afternoon.
examples.zh: 维修人员测试了那部手机一个下午，最后写下「未能复现故障」。

examples.en: I saw “Fault not reproduced” on the report and checked what tests were listed.
examples.zh: 看到报告上的「未能复现故障」后，我查看了列出的测试。

words.enDefinition: a report outcome indicating that inspection detected no identifiable problem

examples.en: The result read no fault found even though the printer stopped again at home.
examples.zh: 检测结果写着「未发现故障」，但打印机回到家后又停了。

examples.en: I kept the no fault found report with the notes from the second inspection.
examples.zh: 我把「未发现故障」的报告与第二次检查的记录放在一起。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of what needs repair and whether the work is feasible

examples.en: The shop's repair assessment described the damaged hinge and the available replacement options.
examples.zh: 维修店的「维修评估」说明了铰链损坏的情况及可选的替换方案。

examples.en: I waited for the repair assessment before deciding whether to replace the printer.
examples.zh: 我等拿到「维修评估」，再决定是不是换掉打印机。

words.enDefinition: a written or spoken explanation of how a product is failing

examples.en: I included the clicking sound in my fault description for the repair technician.
examples.zh: 我给维修人员写「故障描述」时，把咔嗒声也写了进去。

examples.en: The fault description needed to state what happened each time I plugged the charger in.
examples.zh: 「故障描述」要写明我每次插上充电器时发生了什么。

words.enDefinition: a record of the previous repairs carried out on a product

examples.en: The technician looked up the repair history before suggesting a different replacement part.
examples.zh: 维修人员先查了「历次维修记录」，才提出用另一种替换零件。

examples.en: I requested the repair history when the same problem returned during final exams.
examples.zh: 期末考试期间同一问题再次出现时，我索要了「历次维修记录」。

words.enDefinition: a written record of the work and findings from a product service visit

examples.en: The service report showed which parts had been checked by the engineer that morning.
examples.zh: 「检修报告」列出了工程师当天上午检查过的部件。

examples.en: I compared the service report with the work described on the original repair estimate.
examples.zh: 我把「检修报告」与原维修报价上描述的工作做了对照。

words.enDefinition: comments written by the person who inspected or repaired a product

examples.en: The clerk read the technician's notes before explaining why the fan was replaced.
examples.zh: 店员先看了「维修人员记录」，再解释为什么换了风扇。

examples.en: I asked for the technician's notes after the screen started flickering for a second time.
examples.zh: 屏幕第二次开始闪烁后，我索要了「维修人员记录」。

words.enDefinition: a section in a service record naming components that were removed and replaced

examples.en: The report listed parts replaced just above the results of the final test.
examples.zh: 报告在最终测试结果上方列出了「已更换的零件」。

examples.en: I checked the parts replaced section to see whether the new cable was included.
examples.zh: 我查看了「已更换的零件」一栏，确认是否包括新线缆。

words.enDefinition: a description of the actual services carried out on an item

examples.en: The service order listed the work performed beside the charge for each part.
examples.zh: 维修服务单在每项零件费用旁列出「已完成的维修工作」。

examples.en: I compared the work performed with what the technician had promised on Friday.
examples.zh: 我把「已完成的维修工作」与维修人员周五的承诺做了比较。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that the work on a product has finished

examples.en: The message showed repair complete and included the opening hours for pickup that week.
examples.zh: 消息显示「维修已完成」，并附上了当周可取件的营业时间。

examples.en: I saw repair complete in the app while I was waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 我等公交时，在应用里看到了「维修已完成」。

words.enDefinition: a check performed after a repair to confirm the product functions properly

examples.en: The technician ran a post-repair test before returning the printer to the front desk.
examples.zh: 维修人员进行了「维修后测试」，才把打印机拿回前台。

examples.en: A copy of the post-repair test results came with the repaired headphones on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二收到修好的耳机时，附有一份「维修后测试」结果。

words.enDefinition: a test checking whether a product performs the operations it is meant to perform

examples.en: The technician completed a functional test before ruling out a fault with the power switch.
examples.zh: 维修人员做了「功能测试」，才排除电源开关故障。

examples.en: Our lab assistant watched a functional test of the unit after the cable was replaced.
examples.zh: 换完线缆后，实验室助理观看了设备的「功能测试」。

words.enDefinition: a repair that resolves the reported problem on the first attempt

examples.en: The shop described the loose connection as a first-time fix in its service log.
examples.zh: 维修店在服务记录中写明，松动接口「一次修好」。

examples.en: I asked how often an appointment ended with a first-time fix for that fault.
examples.zh: 我问这种故障有多大概率在第一次送修时就「一次修好」。

words.enDefinition: a promise to address certain problems related to recently completed repair work

examples.en: The shop included a repair guarantee with the receipt for the keyboard repair.
examples.zh: 维修店在键盘维修凭条上附上了一份「维修质量保证」。

examples.en: I read the repair guarantee before calling the technician about the loose hinge again.
examples.zh: 我先读了「维修质量保证」，才再次联系维修人员咨询松动的铰链。

words.enDefinition: a warranty covering the unit supplied in place of an earlier one

examples.en: The replacement unit warranty was explained separately from the coverage for my original monitor.
examples.zh: 商家单独说明了「替换整机的保修」，与原显示器的保障分开。

examples.en: I asked if the replacement unit warranty covered the charger packed with it.
examples.zh: 我问「替换整机的保修」是否包括随附的充电器。

words.enDefinition: a complete product supplied to replace a faulty or damaged one

examples.en: The repair centre sent a replacement unit after it inspected the broken power switch.
examples.zh: 维修中心检查损坏的电源开关后，寄来了一台「用于替换的整机」。

examples.en: I compared the serial number on the replacement unit with the one in the email.
examples.zh: 我把「用于替换的整机」上的序列号和邮件中的号码对了一下。

words.enDefinition: a substitute product restored and checked for use after prior use or return

examples.en: The manufacturer offered a refurbished replacement for my old monitor while it reviewed the warranty.
examples.zh: 厂商审核保修时，提出给我的旧显示器换一台「翻新替换品」。

examples.en: I asked whether the refurbished replacement would arrive with a different charging cable.
examples.zh: 我问「翻新替换品」送来时会不会配另一种充电线。

words.enDefinition: a used component restored to a condition in which it can work again

examples.en: The estimate listed a reconditioned part as an option for the older appliance.
examples.zh: 针对这台较旧的电器，报价列了「修复再用部件」这一选项。

examples.en: I checked whether the shop gave a warranty on the reconditioned part it installed.
examples.zh: 我查了店里是否为安装的「修复再用部件」提供保修。

words.enDefinition: too badly damaged to be restored to working condition

examples.en: The technician said the old charger was beyond repair after examining the connector.
examples.zh: 维修人员检查接口后说，旧充电器「已无法修复」。

examples.en: The water-damaged speaker was beyond repair, so the service centre returned it to me.
examples.zh: 进水的音箱「已无法修复」，所以服务中心把它退还给了我。

words.enDefinition: a message reminding customers about saving their data before a device service

examples.en: The repair shop emailed a data backup notice when I booked the appointment online.
examples.zh: 我在网上预约时，维修店发来了一份「数据备份提示」。

examples.en: I read the data backup notice after the technician explained the extent of the work.
examples.zh: 维修人员解释维修范围后，我阅读了「数据备份提示」。

words.zhGloss: 维修代用设备借用协议
words.enDefinition: a written agreement governing temporary use of a device during service
acceptedZhAnswers: 维修代用设备借用协议

examples.en: I signed the service loan agreement before taking the spare laptop back to campus.
examples.zh: 我签了「维修代用设备借用协议」，才把备用笔记本电脑带回校园。

examples.en: The service loan agreement listed the charger as part of the kit to return.
examples.zh: 「维修代用设备借用协议」把充电器列为应归还的配件。

collocations: terms of the service loan agreement

words.enDefinition: additional repair work arranged after an earlier service or inspection

examples.en: The technician offered a follow-up repair after the monitor stopped working again on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日显示器再次坏掉后，维修人员提出安排「后续维修」。

examples.en: I booked a follow-up repair for the week after my final exam ended.
examples.zh: 我预约了「后续维修」，时间在期末考试结束后的那一周。

words.enDefinition: wording introducing when a repair estimate will no longer be valid

examples.en: The message read repair quote expires on Friday, above the revised estimate for parts.
examples.zh: 消息在修订后的零件报价上方写着周五「维修报价到期」。

examples.en: I added the date after repair quote expires to my calendar before calling the shop.
examples.zh: 给店里打电话前，我把「维修报价到期」后面的日期记进了日历。

collocations: repair quote expires on the stated date
check when a repair quote expires

words.enDefinition: a status meaning the required parts have been ordered and are yet to arrive

examples.en: The account showed parts on order after the technician checked the laptop's hinge.
examples.zh: 维修人员检查笔记本电脑的铰链后，账户显示「零件已订购」。

examples.en: The parts on order notice included an expected delivery date for the spare socket.
examples.zh: 「零件已订购」的通知中包括备用插口的预计到货日期。

collocations: parts on order from the supplier

words.enDefinition: a repair option in which the provider picks up and returns the item

examples.en: The company offered a collection and delivery service for printers too large to carry.
examples.zh: 公司为太大不便携带的打印机提供了「上门取送服务」。

examples.en: I asked if the collection and delivery service included buildings on the other campus.
examples.zh: 我问「上门取送服务」是否覆盖另一个校区的楼栋。

collocations: book a collection and delivery service
offer a collection and delivery service

words.enDefinition: a location that accepts and carries out work covered by a warranty

examples.en: The nearest warranty service centre was just beyond the station, opposite the library.
examples.zh: 最近的「保修服务中心」刚过车站，就在图书馆对面。

examples.en: I called the warranty service centre to check which models it could handle locally.
examples.zh: 我打电话给「保修服务中心」，确认当地可以受理哪些型号。

words.enDefinition: passing an existing warranty from one owner of a product to another

examples.en: The seller gave me a separate reference for the warranty transfer after the purchase.
examples.zh: 购买后，卖家单独给了我一个「保修权利转移」的编号。

examples.en: I asked whether the warranty transfer would change the original coverage ending date.
examples.zh: 我问「保修权利转移」是否会改变原来的保修到期日。

words.enDefinition: an increase in the time a warranty remains in effect

examples.en: The service centre confirmed a warranty extension after processing my service request that month.
examples.zh: 服务中心处理我当月的服务申请后，确认了「保修期限延长」。

examples.en: I checked the new expiry date shown after the warranty extension was applied.
examples.zh: 「保修期限延长」生效后，我检查了显示的最新到期日。

words.enDefinition: an action to remove a potentially unsafe product from use or offer a remedy

examples.en: I checked the model numbers listed in a product safety recall for kitchen appliances.
examples.zh: 我对照了厨房电器「产品安全召回」中列出的型号。

examples.en: The store posted details of a product safety recall beside the customer service desk.
examples.zh: 商店在客服台旁张贴了「产品安全召回」的详情。

collocations: affected by a product safety recall

words.enDefinition: a notice identifying a recalled product and explaining the available response

examples.en: The product recall notice listed the affected models and the dates of manufacture.
examples.zh: 「产品召回通知」列出了受影响的型号和生产日期。

examples.en: I forwarded the product recall notice to my flatmate because we shared the appliance.
examples.zh: 电器是和室友共用的，我把「产品召回通知」转发给了室友。

collocations: affected items on a product recall notice

words.enDefinition: a version of a product included in a specified problem or recall

examples.en: My laptop was listed as an affected model on the manufacturer's support page.
examples.zh: 厂商的支持页面把我的笔记本电脑列为「受影响的型号」。

examples.en: I checked the affected model against the number printed on the back of mine.
examples.zh: 我把「受影响的型号」和我的设备背面印的号码做了核对。

words.enDefinition: a set of serial numbers lying between listed starting and ending values

examples.en: The recall notice gave a serial number range underneath each affected product model.
examples.zh: 召回通知在每个受影响的产品型号下列出了「序列号范围」。

examples.en: I matched the sticker on my device to the serial number range in the notice.
examples.zh: 我把设备贴纸上的号码与通知中的「序列号范围」做了比对。

collocations: fall within the serial number range

words.enDefinition: repair work provided without charging the owner for the service

examples.en: The manufacturer offered a free repair for products listed in its safety notice.
examples.zh: 厂商为安全通告中列出的产品提供「免费维修」。

examples.en: I checked whether the free repair included a replacement cable with the charger.
examples.zh: 我确认了「免费维修」是否包含一条替换的充电器线缆。

words.enDefinition: a code marked on a product showing when it was made

examples.en: The product notice told me where to find the manufacture date code on the lamp.
examples.zh: 产品通知告诉我在台灯的什么位置可以找到「生产日期编码」。

examples.en: The technician checked the manufacture date code before ordering a part for my mixer.
examples.zh: 维修人员核对了「生产日期编码」，才为我的搅拌机订购零件。

words.enDefinition: a repair centre operated directly by the product manufacturer

examples.en: The factory service centre offered to inspect the monitor after the local shop declined.
examples.zh: 本地商店没有受理，于是「厂商直营维修中心」提出可以检查显示器。

examples.en: I received an estimate from the factory service centre shortly before leaving for campus.
examples.zh: 出发去校园前不久，我收到了「厂商直营维修中心」的报价。

collocations: send equipment to the factory service centre

words.enDefinition: repair work arranged for an item whose warranty has already expired

examples.en: The shop gave me a separate price for an out-of-warranty repair on the old printer.
examples.zh: 店家另报了旧打印机的「过保维修」价格。

examples.en: I compared the out-of-warranty repair with the cost of replacing the device that week.
examples.zh: 我把「过保维修」与那周更换设备的费用做了比较。
